title: Cases, the nominative and the prepositional

blocks.text: In Russian, the relationship of a noun to the other words in a sentence is shown by changes in the form of the noun:

items.text: The part of a word which changes is called the ending. Each Russian noun has several endings. These endings show two things at the same time:
points: Whether the noun is singular or plural. This is called number.
In what way the noun is used in the sentence. This is called case. There are six cases, each case having a singular form and a plural form. Each case has a special name.

items.text: The nominative case is the basic form in which nouns appear in dictionaries. The main functions of the nominative case are:
points: The nominative of the subject: *Студент читает. Студенты читают.*
The nominative of the predicate: *Мой брат — студент. Мои братья — студенты.*

items.text: The prepositional case is always used with a preposition.
points: With the prepositions **в** and **на** it denotes a location and answers the question **Где?** (Where?): *Студенты в классе. Они на экзамене.*

With the preposition **о**, **об**† this case answers the questions: **О ком?** (About whom?) *Мы говорим о студенте.* **О чём?** (About what?) *Мы говорим о классе.* The basic ending of the prepositional case singular is **-е**.

blocks.text: † об before a "hard" vowel (а, о, у, э) and и: об уроке, об Иване.
Certain neuter nouns of foreign origin never change their forms: **кино**, **радио**, **пальто** — **в кино**, **о радио**, **о пальто**.

points: If the stem of the noun ends in **и-**, the prepositional case singular has another **-и** as the ending (instead of **-е**): **Россия** — **в России**, **здание** — **в здании**.
Feminine nouns ending in **-ь** in the nominative singular have **-и** in the prepositional singular: **тетрадь** — **в тетради**, **часть** — **о части**, **дверь** — **на двери**.

blocks.text: Some masculine nouns take the ending **-у** (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. after the prepositions **в** or **на**. The same nouns have the regular ending **-е** after **о**, **об**. *Я был в лесу, в саду, в аэропорту, на берегу.* Also: **на мосту**, **в полку**, **в** or **на снегу**. However: *Я говорю о лесе, об аэропорте.*
